turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me.
You asked for this meeting, so I assume you have something to say. Why was a mark entered before anyone called me?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
I didn't leave the office early to talk about hockey. Owen, and that zero.
What do you do for fun?
That's not your business, Hale. You've got seventeen minutes to tell me why my son has a zero, or I'm walking down to the principal's office.
